articles.title: ‘No right to protest’: HC raps Imran Khan over anti-CEC stir
articles.description: Mumbai: Bombay High Court Monday lambasted actor Imran Khan, a US citizen, for participating in a protest over the CEC-SIR issue, and noted the fundamental right to protest is available only to Indian citizens, prompting him to tender an unconditional apology. articles.title: Joined the protest, promised not to protest again: Imran Khan tenders ‘unconditional apology’ to Bombay HC
articles.description: Actor Imran Khan apologised to the Bombay High Court over joining a Mumbai protest and gave an undertaking not to participate in similar protests. His FRRO Leave India notice remains on hold till December 7.
